topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: They say change is the only constant. So, when my best friend announced they're moving across the country, it didn’t come as a shock, just another ripple in the ever-flowing stream of life. We sat in the quiet of the evening, the setting sun casting long shadows, and they told me their plans with a mix of excitement and trepidation. I listened, nodding at the right moments, offering a steady presence. Moving changes things, but it doesn’t erase the threads of history that bind us. Our conversations will grow sparse, the visits fewer, but the foundation remains. I’ll miss the spontaneous meet-ups and the silent afternoons, but there’s a certain comfort in knowing, despite the distance, the bond endures.
